analysis_policy: Coordinator never imports/calls the rate analyzer. Root may separately invoke the frozen analyzer after complete global verification; scientific acceptance is not a scheduling-completion result.
failure_records: coordinator-pre-dispatch-failure.json or coordinator-attempts/<uuid>/result.json and exact worker/log/chunk prefixes; no automatic resume or retries
final_time_metadata: Actual saved atomic-unit endpoint must equal 200 fs within a gamma_(N+4) float64 positive-summation bound; N is the registered actual step count.
parent_input_routes: Use the fixed design cohort.relative_directory and bound manifest files. Historical rows are under history-replay/; new rows under new-independent/.
resource_receipt_limit: An externally killed/unresponsive worker may not finish its own receipt. Global failure records mark it unavailable and cannot publish complete eligibility; aggregate reaped-child CPU remains recorded when the coordinator survives.
